description: Robotics R&D: foundation models, world models, benchmarks, research areas, datasets, compute and the humanoid component stack. Curated from a 2026-10-26 research sweep; every record cites its source.

method.vendor_reported: Vendor-reported means the number comes from the company or lab that built the model (or that runs the benchmark and also competes on it). Nobody else has reproduced it. It is shown because it is the only figure available, not because it has been checked.
method.snippet_only: Snippet-only means the claim was read from a search-result snippet or a secondary report because the primary page could not be opened. Treat it as a lead with a source attached, not a confirmed fact.
method.as_of: Leaderboards move. Each benchmark carries the date its numbers were read; a paper table and a live board are shown separately even when they share a name.

benchmarks.name: SimplerEnv and the 2026 validity audit

benchmarks.caveat: No SimplerEnv leaderboard exists.
